# UQDA Core v0.1.0-beta.4

This prerelease cleans up the repository root and removes manual release-version
bookkeeping from the installer and updater.

## Changes

- Moves historical release notes under `.github/releases/`.
- Removes the root `VERSION` file.
- Discovers the newest published GitHub release automatically in both
  `install.sh` and `updater.sh`.
- Keeps `UQDA_VERSION=vX.Y.Z` as an optional explicit version override.
- Adds a fixture-based regression test for automatic release discovery.

Downloaded release payloads remain verified against `SHA256SUMS`. This is
experimental software and has not received an independent security audit.
